responsibility: Builds and finalizes C++ class types. It manages class-scope state while parsing nested classes, checks bases and members, adds implicitly declared special members, lays out fields and base subobjects, computes primary bases and BINFO relationships, and constructs ABI-sensitive virtual dispatch data including vtable layouts, RTTI entries, vcall/vbase offsets, and related hierarchy dumps for RECORD_TYPE/TYPE_BINFO class representations.
